title: Output bit in the circuit encoding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and assign signs from $\{-1,1\}$ to its $n$ input coordinates and one coordinate for each gate. If this assignment satisfies the circuit's width-three CNF encoding, then the sign at the coordinate for the output gate is $-1$, so it represents Boolean true.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
The assignment has one sign coordinate for each input and gate
The width-three CNF encoding evaluates to $-1$
